v.q: Which model leaves the OS patching to the customer?
v.w: With IaaS you rent a virtual machine and patch the guest OS. In the other models the provider manages it.
A Lambda function runs on events, scales to zero and bills per call. EC2 is a virtual machine.

o: A separate data centre in a region
v.w: Zones have independent power, cooling and network, so they fail separately. A region contains several.

v.q: What protects a service from the loss of one data centre?
v.w: Zones fail independently, so spreading the service and the database over two of them survives one failure.

o: The data loss you can accept
v.w: RPO is the most data you may lose, in time. RTO is the time to be back.

v.q: Which DR pattern gives the shortest recovery time?
v.w: Both regions already serve traffic. It also costs the most and needs careful data replication.

v.q: What must an application be to scale out freely?
v.w: Any instance must handle any request, so state moves to shared stores and instances can come and go.

v.q: Why set a maximum size on an auto scaling group?
o: To cap cost if something goes wrong
v.w: A runaway loop or an attack could otherwise create a very large bill.

v.q: Who is responsible for the data stored in a managed database?
v.w: The provider secures the service, but the data, identities and configuration stay with the customer.
Public buckets, open ports, leaked keys and wide roles are the usual causes.

v.q: How should an application on AWS get its credentials?
o: An IAM role with temporary credentials
An access key in the properties
A key baked into the image
v.w: The SDK obtains short-lived credentials from the role, so no secret is stored with the code.

v.q: What is the default result of an IAM request with no matching allow?
v.w: Everything is denied unless allowed, and an explicit deny beats any allow.

v.q: Which cost is often forgotten in the cloud?
v.w: Traffic out of a region, across zones or through a NAT gateway can be a large part of the bill.

v.q: What is a sound way to handle lock-in?
v.w: Managed services bring some lock-in and a lot of value. Keep logic portable and write an exit plan.

v.q: What does rehost mean in a cloud migration?
o: Lift and shift to virtual machines
v.w: The application moves with few changes. It is fast and gets few cloud benefits.

v.q: Why does a bank choose the cloud region carefully?
v.w: Where data is stored is a legal question, and the region decides it.
